title: C-07 and RECKON K9 are the base's companions: on the clearing from the first frame, wireframed, at their true size, wandering, dashing, playing tag and greeting the hull
context: Owner, 2026-10-27: "import the C-07 and Reckon K9 from https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/. for now we just import them as companion who are there early on, built by Isao. default WIREFRAME look. they move around the base freely, sometimes accellerating, sometimes plafuylly chasing each other etc. just a test for a cute feline and canine presence." The site's catalog lists them as mechanical-cheetah (8 clips, 51 joints, 3 LODs) and reckon-k9 (12 clips, 3 LODs); both READMEs give the runtime contract: metres, +Y up, +Z forward, ground origin, in-place gaits with an authored speed_mps each (translate the instance at speed x rate), one-shots LoopOnce clamped, Pounce and Fetch_Return with root motion (not used), LOD2 a static one-draw silhouette. The Ridgebacks (entry 2026-10-23 feids26) set the pattern: a lock with the upstream revision, the plain GLBs under assets/models packed by the build, a host literal in td-tab, a scene module under src/fx with the pure rule under src/domain.
outcome: 1) The assets: assets/models/c07 (c07_d0_lod1/lod2) and assets/models/reckon-k9 (reckon_k9_d0_lod1/lod2) at upstream revision ab4642de, pinned in docs/companions-assets.lock.json with their clips (npm run assets:check reads it); READMEs with the measured tables. 2) src/content/companions.js COMPANIONS: the two units with their gaits in speed order (clip, authored mps, the top of its band), top speed and acceleration (the cheetah 7 m/s at 7 m/s^2, the dog 5.5 at 5), the idle, the sit, the tricks; the play's timings (idle 1.5-4 s, a walk at 0.45-0.65 m/s, a dash at 0.75-1 of the top, tag 8-14 s with the fleer at 0.75 of its top, a tag within 1.6 m, games 20-45 s apart, the first at 8 s; a trot to the hull and a sit 3 m from it, 25 s in, then 40-90 s apart); the roam 6 cells from the heart; 90 m to the far tier. 3) src/domain/companion-play.js (pure): createPlay / stepPlay over the pair: idle | wander | dash | chase / flee | greet / greeted | sit | trick; the game of tag swaps the roles on a tag, ends at its time; a pair further than 25 m apart trots together first; a blocked move retargets; gaitFor picks the clip by the speed band and clamps the rate to 0.45-1.6. 4) src/fx/companions.js: each unit a wrap on the unit sphere holding the cloned game tier (its own skeleton, AnimationMixer, the clips by name) and the hidden far tier; the speed ramps at the unit's acceleration (decelerates twice as fast), the heading turns toward the goal at turn / (1 + speed / 2.5) so a dash arcs; a move onto a cell off the roam (the clearing within roamCells of the heart), into a solid structure (storyBase.solidAt, asked live since the structures' models land after the world) or onto the hull's keep-off (2.5 m, unless greeting) is refused and reported as blocked; the clip is the one-shot in place, else the gait at speed / mps, else the idle; crossfades of 0.25 s; the far tier past 90 m, back inside 75. Tokens resolved on the sphere: 'pick' a roam cell clear of solids, 'away' the farthest from the other among near roam points (within 20 m), 'detour' a near cell, 'other' and 'hull' live. 5) src/td-tab.js: the host after `graph = dungeon.graph` (created before it, the roam scan threw and the page never came ready: the first run's load timeout), ticked with the squad, state().companions, the radar's friendlies include them, ?pets=0 leaves them out (src/platform/game-flags.js), the harness petLook(i) (src/fx/reinforcements-host.js look now takes any frameOf holder with its own offset and height). 6) The terminal: c07 and k9 in the colony section, open from the start, Isao's lines, the gallop on the bench. 7) test/companions.mjs; the --companions browser step.
alternatives: Cell-stepping like the Ridgebacks (cur -> next at a pace): the play wants bursts, arcs and a chase that closes; a continuous heading at a ramping speed reads as an animal, the cells only bound the roam.
The roam as the whole clearing (150 m): the pair vanished from the base; six cells from the heart keeps them among the buildings.

A game of tag from any distance: the first run showed the chaser never closing 45-80 m in 11 s; the pair trots together first, the fleer dodges within 20 m, the game runs 8-14 s at 0.75 of the fleer's top.
Pounce and Fetch_Return: both carry root motion on MOTION (the body would snap back at the clip's end); left out until a root-motion transfer is written.
evidence: npm test 310 (new test/companions.mjs: the four pins match and carry their clips, the gaits in speed order and within the clips, the play reaches nine modes with games of tag and tags, both reach their top in a chase, no hull no greeting, deterministic per seed, a far pair trots together first; gaitFor bands and clamps), npm run check (td-tab 5,350 under 5,450), npm run architecture green.

--companions PASS (four runs; the first timed out at load: the host created before graph = dungeon.graph, fixed by moving it after; the second showed no tag in 70 s with the pair 45-80 m apart, hence the approach, the near dodge and the longer game; the third tagged at 21 s; the fourth, with the cheetah's own trot): both loaded, 6/6 meshes wired each, a roam of 93 cells; over 70 game s and 138 samples: c07 dash / idle / wander / chase / flee / greet / greeted / sit, k9 idle / sit / wander / flee / chase / dash; tops 7 and 5.5 m/s; clips c07 Gallop / Watch_Idle / Feline_Walk / Sit_Down, k9 Alert_Idle / Sit_Down / Walk / Run / Gallop / Sprint; 2 games, 1 tag (3.5 m apart, the roles swapped); 0 samples off the roam; the cheetah loping at 4 m/s on the gallop at 0.65; the look beside the cheetah at 4 m fleeing at 5.25 m/s (artifacts/browser/companions.png, -k9.png).
Draw cost in the look's frame: 1958-2316 calls, 59-60 fps headless on the base (each game tier is 6 draws, the far tier 1).
